notes.title: Mission 4 Available
notes.content:
A new mission is available, with new blocks, enemy types, cinematics and story progression. Join us! Play through it, and give your feedback. Is it too easy? To difficult? Anything you would like to see changed?

Let's test the waters, we are really excited to hear what you have to say!

notes.title: Mission 4 Preparation
notes.content: We've added a few more blocks and units, for testing and preparing for the release of the next content patch, which will include Mission 4. Help us test it!

notes.title: Small fixes
notes.content:
- Fixed UI for ultrawide monitors
- Changed some units size and hitboxes for balancing

notes.title: Vote for Rogue Waves at the GDWC 2021!
notes.content:
Rogue Waves is running up for the Fan Favorite at the Game Development World Championship - GDWC 2021.

Vote until May 3rd, 10:00 AM Finnish time (GMT+3) at:
https://thegdwc.com/

notes.title: 0.3.9 Available
notes.content:
- Reworked mission 3 (Wetto Run).
- New block added: Radar. It will detect and warn you of nearby entities.
- Recharger block now can store extra energy. Keep draining to enter Supercharge mode.
- Added key binding and an option to invert mouse Y.
- Improved AI for many situations.
- Other small fixes and improvements.

Feedback wanted! Tell us what you think.

notes.title: Small fixes
notes.content:
- Error message if a weapon is aiming at your own ship
- Small fixes and balance

notes.title: Available on January 14th!
notes.content:
We have been working on this project for over 3 years now, and we are thrilled to announce that Rogue Waves will be available on Early Access by January 14th, 2021.

Wishlist it now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1147240/Rogue_Waves/

The game will be released with 3 missions on Story Mode, and Sandbox Mode will also be available. We are currently doing large scale testing, and plan to add new missions regularity.

See you there!
